title: Vanishing of derived tensor cohomology with an O_X-module
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], E an object of D(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], F a sheaf of \mathcal O_X-modules, and i an integer. The predicate H^i(E\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}F)=0 means that there exists a K-flat complex P [def-pc-kflat-complex] of \mathcal O_X-modules whose image in D(\mathcal O_X) is isomorphic to E, such that H^i(\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes F[0]))=0. Here F[0] is F placed in degree zero and the total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] has term \bigoplus_{p+q=n}P^p\otimes F[0]^q and differential d_P\otimes1+(-1)^p1\otimes d_{F[0]}; K-flat replacement and independence of replacement make this precisely derived tensor cohomology vanishing.
